nbtech2fix.commands.config.invalid: Config entry %s does not accept value %s
nbtech2fix.configuration.title: NBTech2Fix Configuration
nbtech2fix.configuration.invalid_integer: %s must be an integer from %s to %s
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixAECraftNBT: [Optimization] Allow configured AE processing inputs to differ in NBT
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixAECraftNBT.t: DISABLED: off; DE_ONLY: ignore NBT only for Draconic Evolution items; ALL: ignore NBT for every item. The actual output NBT is preserved.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixBrandonsCore: Treats null ProcessHandlerClient entries as dead so they are removed before isDead is called.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixDECuriosOrde: [Optimization] Make DE shield selection independent of Curios order
Selects modular armor that actually contains a shield controller instead of only the first Curios item.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixDEDislocator: Sends the destination sound on the current server thread instead of accessing the teleported entity from a delayed task.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixDEHUDRenderB: [Fix] Draconic Evolution HUD shield, energy and undying counts
Aggregates the chest and Curios module hosts, selects valid shield/energy sources and totals all undying modules.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixMMSMEnergySh: [Fix] MoreMekaSuitModules death prevention without a shield module
When the shield is disabled, the handler no longer drains energy or prevents death.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixObNetStuck.t: DISABLED: off; TIMEOUT: apply connect/read timeouts; NO_UPLOAD: disable uploading.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixObNoOshiFile: Runs OSHI diagnostics on a daemon thread and returns empty diagnostics after the timeout.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixPackagedDEDo: [Fix] Packaged Draconic ignores the actual input
Passes and splits the actual AE2 inputHolder stacks so the Fusion Crafter preserves module and other item NBT.
nbtech2fix.configuration.FixPlayerShells: Fires the cancellable death event first so MMSM, Draconic Evolution and similar prevention mechanics can act before consciousness transfer.
nbtech2fix.configuration.ObNoFileTimeout: Timeout for the system diagnostics fix in milliseconds. Default: 3000.
nbtech2fix.configuration.ObservableUploa: Used when the upload fix is set to TIMEOUT, in milliseconds. Default: 3000.
